name: Tscherms (Italy)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged with the municipal arms of Tscherms (a red lion on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Tscherms, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Tscherms arms — red lion on yellow
